ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC=9\text{cm}$, $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$, intersecting $AB$ and $AC$ at points $D$ and $E$, respectively. If $BC=5\text{cm}$, what is the perimeter of $\triangle BCE$ in $\text{cm}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$,\\
it follows that $AE=BE$,\\
given $AC=9\text{cm}$, $BC=5\text{cm}$, and $AE=BE$,\\
thus, the perimeter of $\triangle BCE$ is $BC+BE+CE=BC+AE+CE=BC+AC=9\text{cm}+5\text{cm}=\boxed{14\text{cm}}$.
